DEMO: Low Poly Flower Pack 1.0 — Emilulz
https://assetstore.unity.com/packages/3d/vegetation/flowers/demo-low-poly-flower-pack-325074
Five original models and the demo atlas provide daisy, hyacinth, dandelion,
red rose and black rose. The existing six beds receive 452 upright flowers.
Decorative flowers have no physical colliders and do not create safety shadows.
No third-party scripts or demo scenes are imported.

Acquired 2026-11-09. Standard Unity Asset Store EULA:
https://unity.com/legal/as-terms
Original asset hashes and source paths are recorded in the imported package's
source.json. Source asset bytes are retained; Unity import settings and generated
rendering assets are adapted for Built-in rendering.
